evidence: Both publications describe NASA JSC historical chamber evidence with overlapping years. The 1982–1998 poster reports 548 exposures and 84 DCS cases. The 1983–2007 lecture reports 914 and 121. No common participant or exposure identifiers were published.
The 2002 Grade IV report contains 549 NASA records with one interval excluded. The 2007 VGE chart represents 783 exposures. Scope and matching record identities are unresolved.

The 2019 Table F1 series covers 1983–2016 and reports 1,031 source exposures, 1,030 clinically evaluable exposures and 125 cases. Its eligibility and time bounds differ from the 2007 snapshot. Individual overlap is unresolved.

The NASA evidence report presents 220 symptoms in 119 cases and references the earlier 103-case description. Its counted unit differs from the 2007 exposure denominator. Case membership is unreported.
